log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Lead Grimmsnarl+Archaludon. Grimmsnarl Fake Out flinches Sneasler/Manectric/Sinistcha turn 1, blocking Unburden, Scarf Volt Switch, or Trick Room. Archaludon Electro Shot 4x KOs Pelipper in its own Drizzle rain. Politoed backs up rain if Pelipper dies early; Garganacl gives Wide Guard vs Rock Slide/Snarl and TR insurance. No Mega on my team; opponent's Mega is Blastoise.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Pelipper (Drizzle/DampRock), Sneasler (Unburden/White Herb, Close Combat spam), Manectric (Choice Scarf/LightningRod), Blastoise (Blastoisinite/Torrent, Mega Launcher), Houndoom (Flash Fire/SitrusBerry — not brought G2), Sinistcha (Trick Room/Leftovers — not brought G2). Opponent favors rain core with Manectric speed control. Sneasler relies on Close Combat to trigger White Herb+Unburden speed doubling; if blocked by Protect or Fake Out flinch, it stays slow. Blastoise Mega evolution was delayed through turn 4 in G2. LightningRod redirects Electro Shot even if Manectric is flinched. Archaludon resists Electric (Steel) and takes neutral from Fighting (Steel SE/Dragon NVE cancel). In rain, Fire moves vs Archaludon are NVE. Series tied 1-1; game 3 decisive. Key plan: Fake Out prevents Unburden/TR, KO Pelipper 4x with Electro Shot, sweep in rain. Garganacl is TR insurance and Wide Guard for spread moves.

decisions.rationale: Lead Pelipper sets rain and wins weather war vs Politoed (Politoed 70 base Spe moves first but Pelipper overrides). Sneasler threatens Archaludon with SE Close Combat, outspeeds with 172 base, and White Herb removes the Def/Spd drops. Back: Blastoise Mega Evolves turn 1 for rain-boosted Hydro Pump and Mega Launcher Aura Sphere (SE on Archaludon). Houndoom provides Fire coverage when rain ends, Dark Pulse for Ghosts, and Taunt to block Grimmsnarl screens if it appears.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs rain (Politoed, Sitrus) with Archaludon (Stamina, Life Orb) as the win condition and Grimmsnarl (Light Clay, Prankster) for Reflect/Light Screen support. Staraptor carries Final Gambit and pairs with Grimmsnarl Fake Out to delete one opposing Pokemon on turn 1 — treat this combo as a hard removal threat when previewing. Archaludon uses Protect aggressively to stack Stamina boosts and is very difficult to OHKO even with super-effective Close Combat; need multiple hits or a different answer (Blastoise-Mega Aura Sphere with Mega Launcher boost, or Noivern Hurricane in rain if they drop Archaludon). Reflect was set turn 2 and lasted the whole game — physical attackers need Infiltrator or screen-breaking support. Blastoise Mega must Mega Evolve immediately on entry; do not sit on the item. Manectric is unsafe vs Fake Out users and should only be brought when Staraptor/Grimmsnarl are absent. Sinistcha is immune to both Fake Out (Normal) and Final Gambit (Fighting) — consider as a pivot answer to the deletion combo. Future plan: if opponent keeps this core, lead Pelipper + Sneasler, bring Blastoise-Mega + Houndoom as the back, and Mega Evolve Blastoise the turn it enters to threaten Politoed before Archaludon stabilizes.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler outspeeds Archaludon and Close Combat is a guaranteed OHKO (124-216%). Fake Out on Sneasler is mandatory to prevent this. Electro Shot is a guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper (221-531%, 4x SE + Life Orb). If Pelipper Protects, we lose nothing — Sneasler is flinched, no damage taken, and next turn Pelipper can't Protect again while Sneasler is still slow without Unburden triggered.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 decisive. Sneasler Close Combat guaranteed OHKOs Archaludon (124-216%) — must Fake Out Sneasler every lead turn or Archaludon dies before acting. Electro Shot guaranteed OHKOs Pelipper (221-531%). If Pelipper Protects turn 1, repeat Electro Shot turn 2 (can't Protect twice). Opponent may switch Pelipper to Manectric (LightningRod redirects Electro Shot) — if so, pivot to Draco Meteor or Flash Cannon on Sneasler. Garganacl held in back as TR insurance and Wide Guard for Rock Slide. Plan: KO Pelipper, keep Archaludon alive, sweep in rain with Electro Shot SpA boosts.

decisions.rationale: Aggressive open to pressure both foes. Sneasler Close Combat on Archaludon deals massive 2x SE damage and forces a Protect or a near-OHKO; Pelipper Hydro Pump on Grimmsnarl is the best neutral hit (110 BP Water STAB, 80% acc) and prevents free Reflect/Light Screen setup. If Grimmsnarl Fakes Out Sneasler, Sneasler flinches but Pelipper still lands a solid hit on Grimmsnarl. If Archaludon Protects, I scout the Stamina play and Grimmsnarl takes chip. Main risk is Pelipper eating 4x SE Electro Shot,

Blastoise-Mega Aura Sphere with Mega Launcher boost is the cleanest answer to Archaludon; must Mega Evolve the turn Blastoise enters. Future plan vs this core: lead Pelipper + Sneasler, back Blastoise-Mega + Houndoom, Mega Evolve Blastoise on entry to threaten Politoed/Archaludon before Stamina stabilizes.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper fainted to Electro Shot. Blastoise-Mega with Mega Launcher Aura Sphere is the cleanest answer to Archaludon (SE Fighting coverage) and threatens Politoed too. Mega on entry per plan. Sneasler passes — Close Combat is resisted by Steel, Poison Jab into Grimmsnarl risks a Taunt answer, and Sneasler is at 76% after the flinch.
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain core: Politoed+Archaludon+Grimmsnarl screens. Archaludon Stamina + Life Orb is the wincon; needs SE coverage to break. Blastoise-Mega Aura Sphere (Mega Launcher boost) is the answer — must Mega on entry. Grimmsnarl runs Fake Out / Reflect / Light Screen / Taunt with Light Clay; Fake Out used turn 1. Staraptor+Grimmsnarl deletion combo (Fake Out + Final Gambit) is a hard removal threat — Sinistcha immune to both is the pivot answer. Reflect lasted whole game previously; physical attackers need Infiltrator or screen-breaking support. Future plan: lead Pelipper+Sneasler, back Blastoise-Mega+Houndoom, Mega on Blastoise entry.

decisions.rationale: Reflect (Prankster priority) goes up before Sneasler attacks, cutting Close Combat to 45.8–64.7% — Archaludon guaranteed survives. Draco Meteor at +1 SpA with Life Orb is guaranteed OHKO on Sneasler at 76% (102.7–233.5%). Opponent is behind and most likely Close Combats to remove Archaludon; even Rock Slide loses since Sneasler isn't Protecting. SpA drop to -1 is acceptable — Sneasler is removed and Archaludon can be switched out to reset.
decisions.notebook: Draco Meteor at +1 SpA + Life Orb guaranteed OHKOs Sneasler at 76%+ (102.7–233.5%). Electro Shot at +1 not guaranteed (67.9–155.5%). Close Combat on Archaludon: 91.6–129.3% without Reflect, 45.8–64.7% with Reflect (guaranteed survival). Close Combat blocked by Protect does NOT trigger White Herb/Unburden (secondary effects don't occur on blocked moves). Sneasler Adamant, likely 252 Atk/252 Spe. Garganacl switch-in with Reflect up takes neutral Close Combat (2x SE halved). Plan: KO Sneasler via Draco Meteor, switch Archaludon out to reset SpA drop, bring back later to sweep with Electro Shot in rain. Manectric LightningRod shuts down Electro Shot — use Draco Meteor or Flash Cannon if Manectric is active.

decisions.rationale: Politoed resists Blastoise's rain-boosted Hydro Pump (the biggest threat to Grimmsnarl's slot), benefits from Reflect halving physical hits, and can retaliate with STAB rain Weather Ball. Garganacl is quad-weak to the opponent's Fighting and Water moves and would die immediately. Politoed is the only safe switch.
decisions.notebook: Draco Meteor at +1 SpA + Life Orb guaranteed OHKOs Sneasler at 76%+ (102.7–233.5%). Electro Shot at +1 not guaranteed (67.9–155.5%). Close Combat on Archaludon: 91.6–129.3% without Reflect, 45.8–64.7% with Reflect (guaranteed survival). Close Combat blocked by Protect does NOT trigger White Herb/Unburden. Sneasler Adamant, likely 252 Atk/252 Spe. Garganacl switch-in with Reflect up takes neutral Close Combat (2x SE halved). Manectric LightningRod shuts down Electro Shot — use Draco Meteor or Flash Cannon if Manectric is active. Blastoise-Mega Modest, speed 98-130, carries Hydro Pump/Ice Beam/Aura Sphere/Dark Pulse. Sneasler Unburden active (280-344 speed), White Herb consumed. Opponent backline: Houndoom (Flash Fire, Timid, Sitrus), Manectric (LightningRod, Scarf, Timid), Sinistcha (Hospitality, Sassy, Leftovers). Reflect is ally-side so incoming switch benefits too. Politoed resists Blastoise Hydro Pump; Garganacl is weak to CC/Hydro Pump/Aura Sphere — avoid switching Garganacl into Blastoise.

decisions.rationale: Must Mega Blastoise on entry per plan. Focus fire Archaludon: Sneasler Close Combat (62-109%, possible OHKO) + Blastoise-Mega Aura Sphere (Mega Launcher boost to 120 BP, 2x SE Fighting vs Steel, ignores Stamina since special). Archaludon at +1 SpA with Life Orb is the wincon—must remove it now. Sneasler CC triggers White Herb→Unburden, doubling Sneasler speed next turn for cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain core: Politoed+Archaludon+Grimmsnarl screens. Archaludon Stamina + Life Orb is the wincon; needs SE coverage to break. Blastoise-Mega Aura Sphere (Mega Launcher boost) is the answer—must Mega on entry. Grimmsnarl runs Fake Out / Reflect / Light Screen / Taunt with Light Clay; Fake Out used turn 1. Staraptor+Grimmsnarl deletion combo (Fake Out + Final Gambit) is a hard removal threat. Reflect lasted whole game previously; physical attackers need Infiltrator or screen-breaking support. Future plan: lead Pelipper+Sneasler, back Blastoise-Mega+Houndoom, Mega on Blastoise entry. After CC+Unburden, Sneasler hits 344 effective speed—cleanup threat.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Politoed)
decisions.rationale: Prankster Light Screen guarantees special screen before any attacks, preventing Blastoise Hydro Pump OHKO on Grimmsnarl (47-156% → ~24-78%). Hydro Pump on Sneasler is the only move with KO potential at 76% HP (35-123% range). Removing the 280-344 speed Unburden threat is worth the 80% acc risk. Even if it misses or Sneasler Protects, both screens are up and both mons survive.
decisions.notebook: Blastoise-Mega Hydro Pump on Grimmsnarl: 47-156% raw, ~24-78% with Light Screen — Light Screen is mandatory for Grimmsnarl survival. Sneasler Poison Jab on Grimmsnarl with Reflect: ~24-83% (halved from 49-166%). Politoed Hydro Pump on Sneasler: 35-123% (possible OHKO at 76%), Ice Beam: 13-45% (no KO). Garganacl must avoid switching into Blastoise (2x SE Water/Fighting weak). Win condition: both screens up → Politoed rain-boosted attacks wear down foe → Garganacl late-game Salt Cure cleanup. Houndoom Flash Fire blocks Water moves; Manectric Scarf+LightningRod shuts Electric attacks. Sinistcha Sassy TR setter in backline.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler at 344 effective speed (Unburden) outspeeds the entire field. Poison Jab into Grimmsnarl is SE (2x vs Fairy) and removes the Taunt/Reflect support threat—critical since Taunt would strip Sneasler's Protect and enable Staraptor Final Gambit. Blastoise-Mega Aura Sphere (Mega Launcher 1.25x, never misses) into Politoed applies reliable special pressure on the rain setter; Hydro Pump has higher theoretical damage but 80% acc risks a miss on a key turn. Both targets are optimal: Sneasler rem
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain core: Politoed+Archaludon+Grimmsnarl screens. Archaludon Stamina + Life Orb was the wincon—KO'd by Blastoise-Mega Aura Sphere (Mega Launcher boost). Must Mega on entry. Grimmsnarl runs Fake Out / Reflect / Light Screen / Taunt with Light Clay; Fake Out used turn 1, Reflect up turn 2. Staraptor+Grimmsnarl deletion combo (Fake Out + Final Gambit) is a hard removal threat—must remove Grimmsnarl before Staraptor enters. Reflect reduces physical by 50%; Sneasler Poison Jab into Fairy still nets 1x effective (2x SE × 0.5x Reflect). Noivern has Infiltrator to bypass screens. Future plan: lead Pelipper+Sneasler, back Blastoise-Mega+Houndoom, Mega on Blastoise entry. After CC+Unburden, Sneasler hits 344 effective speed—cleanup threat. Houndoom Flash Fire absorbs Fire moves; pair with Sneasler for Fire/Fighting coverage.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Weather Ball is 100% accurate vs Hydro Pump's 80%, still 2x SE on Houndoom in rain with STAB. Taunt on Houndoom prevents future Protect/Taunt if Houndoom chooses to attack instead. Even if Houndoom Protects this turn, I haven't lost board state — screens still up, Garganacl fresh. Grimmsnarl at 40% risks KO from Blastoise Hydro Pump through Light Screen (~24-78%), but keeping pressure on Houndoom is critical before screens expire.
decisions.notebook: Blastoise-Mega Hydro Pump on Garganacl with Light Screen: ~27-88% (risky switch-in). Garganacl must enter only when Blastoise is not targeting its slot or when screens guarantee survival. Win condition: KO Houndoom first → bring Garganacl to Salt Cure Blastoise with screens still active. Blastoise-Mega has no recovery; Salt Cure + Leftovers stall wins long-term. Houndoom Sitrus Berry heals 25% at 50% threshold — need >100% damage to KO through berry. Weather Ball (100 BP Water in rain, 100% acc) preferred over Hydro Pump (80% acc) for consistency in decider. Opponent has no switches remaining (only Blastoise + Houndoom alive).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Grimmsnarl at 39% is the lynchpin: removing it now breaks the Staraptor Final Gambit deletion combo. Grimmsnarl has no Protect, so it will either Fake Out Houndoom (priority) or Taunt. Houndoom Fire Blast (110 BP STAB) and Blastoise Aura Sphere (80 BP STAB + Mega Launcher 1.5x = 180 effective) into Dark/Fairy through Light Screen both OHKO at 39%. Even if Grimmsnarl Fakes Out Houndoom (faster priority), Blastoise's Aura Sphere alone should KO through the 50% special screen. Removing Grimmsnarl a
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain core: Politoed+Grimmsnarl screens remain. Archaludon Stamina+Life Orb wincon already KO'd by Blastoise Aura Sphere (Mega Launcher). Must Mega Blastoise on entry. Grimmsnarl runs Fake Out/Reflect/Light Screen/Taunt with Light Clay; no Protect. Staraptor+Grimmsnarl deletion combo (Fake Out+Final Gambit) is the hard removal threat—priority is removing Grimmsnarl before Staraptor enters. Noivern has Infiltrator to bypass screens. Houndoom Flash Fire absorbs Fire; pair with Sneasler for Fire/Fighting coverage. After CC+Unburden, Sneasler hits 344 effective speed—cleanup threat. Future plan: preserve Houndoom+Blastoise-Mega as endgame core, use Sneasler as cleanup after Unburden boost.

decisions.rationale: Hydro Pump can OHKO Garganacl through Light Screen (41-131% range). Protect guarantees Garganacl survives at 100% to Salt Cure next turn — Blastoise has no Protect to dodge it. Weather Ball chips at 100% acc. Even if Blastoise targets Politoed instead, all hits are survivable through screens. Salt Cure stall wins once applied; no need to gamble the win condition this turn.
decisions.notebook: Blastoise-Mega Hydro Pump on Garganacl through Light Screen: ~41-131% — can OHKO even with screens. Aura Sphere through Light Screen: ~14-42% — safe. Blastoise has no Protect in moveset (Hydro Pump, Ice Beam, Aura Sphere, Dark Pulse). Win condition: Salt Cure on Blastoise → Leftovers stall; Blastoise has zero recovery. Always Protect Garganacl when Hydro Pump OHKO risk exists; Salt Cure only when Garganacl is guaranteed to survive the turn. Weather Ball (100 BP Water in rain, 100% acc, STAB) preferred over Hydro Pump (80% acc) for consistent chip. Speed tie: Blastoise 98-130 vs Politoed 100 — uncertain order.

decisions.rationale: Only Blastoise-Mega alive. Salt Cure 1/8 residual = 12.5%/turn + immediate 10-19% is the lethal threat. Hydro Pump into Garganacl has 130-236% range (65-118% after Light Screen halving) - real OHKO chance with STAB+Rain+2x SE. Politoed cannot be OHKOd. 130 Speed outspeeds both. Must remove Garganacl.
decisions.notebook: Mega Blastoise can solo both rain leads via Aura Sphere/Hydro Pump 2x SE on Garganacl. Rain Politoed outspeeds non-Mega Blastoise. Sneasler Unburden at 344 Spe cleanup threat. Houndoom Flash Fire absorbs Fire. Final Gambit Staraptor+Grimmsnarl Fake Out is the hard removal threat. Noivern Infiltrator bypasses screens. Light Clay on Grimmsnarl extends screens to 8 turns.

decisions.rationale: Salt Cure is the win condition — Blastoise has no Protect or recovery, so landing it guarantees victory in 2-3 turns. Hydro Pump has 80% acc and Light Screen may prevent OHKO (~68-148% range). If Garganacl survives at low HP, full-rate Protect next turn stalls Blastoise to death. If Garganacl falls, Weather Ball chip makes 1v1 playable. Protecting now (33% success) just delays the same gamble with worse odds.
decisions.notebook: Blastoise-Mega: Modest, all special moves (Hydro Pump/Ice Beam/Aura Sphere/Dark Pulse), NO Protect, NO recovery. Salt Cure does 25%/turn to Water types. Light Screen reduces Hydro Pump on Garganacl to ~68-148% (not guaranteed OHKO). Blastoise-Mega base SpA 155; with Modest + likely max SpA EVs, Hydro Pump through Light Screen probably OHKOs Garganacl (~120-148%), but 80% acc means ~20% whiff chance. Win path: Salt Cure → Protect stall → Leftovers recovery on Garganacl. Politoed Weather Ball (100 BP Water in rain, STAB, 100% acc) chips Blastoise 16-38% (NVE). Politoed vs Blastoise 1v1: Politoed all attacks NVE, Blastoise Hydro Pump/Ice Beam NVE on Politoed, Dark Pulse neutral — grindy but Politoed has Sitrus Berry advantage.

decisions.rationale: 1v2 with Blastoise at 69%. Politoed Hydro Pump (~46%) + Garganacl Salt Cure (25%/turn on Water) deletes me unless I OHKO one. Politoed at 73% cannot be OHKOed by any move (max Dark Pulse ~41%). Garganacl can be OHKOed by Hydro Pump — base range 118-261% is guaranteed OHKO unscreened; through Light Screen (50%) the range becomes ~59-130% so the OHKO is a roll-dependent but real chance to drop the Salt Cure threat. decisions.notebook: Game 3 series-decider. My team: Pelipper/Houndoom/Sneasler all fainted; only Blastoise-Mega survives. Opponent revealed sets: Politoed Modest Drizzle Sitrus, Garganacl Impish PurifyingSalt Leftovers Wide Guard+Salt Cure, Archaludon Modest Stamina Life Orb, Grimmsnarl Adamant Prankster LightClay Fake Out/Reflect/Light Screen/Taunt. Noivern (Timid ExpertBelt Infiltrator) and Staraptor (Jolly FocusSash Intimidate) held in reserve. Garganacl routinely runs Impish with low SpD EV, so my Hydro Pump base 118-261% is favored for OHKO. Light Screen on opponent side reduces my special damage by 50% — key factor for any OHKO calc. Politoed outspeeds only if Modest max (122) but still slower than Mega Blastoise (130).

decisions.rationale: Blastoise-Mega is at 10% with Salt Cure ticking 25%/turn — it faints at end of turn regardless. Weather Ball does ~29% (confirmed by prior hits), guaranteeing the KO even before Salt Cure. Garganacl Protects to avoid any SE Hydro Pump/Aura Sphere damage. This is the cleanest, safest line to close out game 3.
decisions.notebook: Blastoise-Mega: Modest, all special (Hydro Pump/Ice Beam/Aura Sphere/Dark Pulse), NO Protect, NO recovery. Salt Cure does 25%/turn to Water types. Opponent team composition tendencies: Pelipper+Houndoom+Sneasler+Blastoise brought game 3; Manectric+Sinistcha left in back. Opponent favors aggressive SE targeting (Aura Sphere on Archaludon/Grimmsnarl, Hydro Pump on Garganacl). Houndoom Flash Fire immune to Fire. Sneasler Unburden+White Herb speed boost after item consumption. Win path vs last-mon stall: Salt Cure → Protect → Leftovers recovery on Garganacl.

decisions.rationale: I'm at 11% with Salt Cure ticking 1/4 max per turn on Water — I faint at end of turn regardless. Maximize damage dealt: Hydro Pump into Garganacl is 2x SE Water vs Impish (low SpD) and even halved by Light Screen should OHKO or near-OHKO. Politoed takes NVE and survives. Houndoom is fainted, slot 2 is moot.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 series-decider. My team: Pelipper/Houndoom/Sneasler all fainted; only Blastoise-Mega survives at 11% with Salt Cure — will faint end of turn. Opponent revealed: Politoed Modest Drizzle Sitrus, Garganacl Impish PurifyingSalt Leftovers Wide Guard+Salt Cure, Archaludon Modest Stamina Life Orb, Grimmsnarl Adamant Prankster LightClay. Noivern/Staraptor held in reserve. Light Clay screens up. Key lesson: Light Screen halves my special damage — must account for in OHKO calcs. Impish Garganacl has low SpD so SE Water still OHKOes through LS. Politoed Modest max 122 Spe still slower than Mega Blastoise 130.

reflections.summary: Won because Grimmsnarl's screens softened early aggression, Politoed's rain-boosted Weather Ball traded favorably (KO'd Houndoom, chipped Blastoise-Mega), and Garganacl's Salt Cure + Protect stall cleanly finished a Blastoise-Mega that has no Protect or recovery. Opponent's four-mon bring had no answer to Garganacl once Sneasler was removed.
reflections.adjustment: Archaludon contributed nothing before fainting—evaluate whether it was the right fourth slot or if a different pick (e.g., something that pressures Pelipper lead or covers Archaludon's weaknesses better) would be safer. Otherwise, the Salt Cure→Protect→Leftovers stall pattern against Blastoise-Mega is confirmed effective and should be the default endgame plan.
reflections.notebook: Blastoise-Mega: Modest, all special (Hydro Pump/Ice Beam/Aura Sphere/Dark Pulse), NO Protect, NO recovery—fully vulnerable to Salt Cure stall. Salt Cure does 25%/turn to Water types. Opponent game-3 bring: Pelipper+Houndoom+Sneasler+Blastoise; Manectric+Sinistcha left in back. Opponent favors aggressive SE targeting (Aura Sphere on Archaludon/Grimmsnarl, Hydro Pump on Garganacl). Houndoom Flash Fire immune to Fire; Timid. Sneasler Unburden+White Herb speed boost after item consumption; Adamant. Win path vs Blastoise-Mega endgame: Salt Cure → Protect → Leftovers recovery on Garganacl. Archaludon underperformed this game—reassess its slot value. Manectric (Scarf, LightningRod, Timid) and Sinistcha (TR, Matcha Gotcha, Sassy, Leftovers) remain unrevealed in back—expect potential TR or fast Volt Switch pressure if brought next game.

reflections.summary: Lost because the team-preview plan was fundamentally flawed against this opponent. Bringing Pelipper (Drizzle) into an opposing Politoed (Drizzle) meant my rain setter was redundant and contributed nothing offensively. Sneasler and Houndoom are both extremely frail and were OHKO'd in one hit each by Politoed's rain-boosted Water/Weather Ball, leaving Blastoise-Mega alone to face a defensive Garganacl+Politoed core. reflections.adjustment: Never bring Pelipper when the opponent already has Politoed — the Drizzle clash wastes a slot and forfeits weather control. Against a Politoed+Garganacl rain core, swap the Mega to something that hits Garganacl neutrally and ignores Protect (e.g., a special attacker with spread coverage or a strong physical breaker like Kingambit/Dragonite), and pair it with a dedicated Garganacl answer (Taunt user or a Pokemon running non-Water special moves like Earth Power/Energy Ball). Also, do not lead both
reflections.notebook: Series lost 1-2. Durable opponent tendencies confirmed: Opponent runs Politoed Modest Drizzle Sitrus + Garganacl Impish PurifyingSalt Leftovers (Protect + Wide Guard + Salt Cure) as a defensive rain core, backed by Archaludon Modest Stamina LifeOrb and Grimmsnarl Adamant Prankster LightClay (Fake Out/Reflect/Light Screen/Taunt). Noivern (Infiltrator ExpertBelt) and Staraptor (Focus Sash Intimidate) held in reserve. Key strategic facts: (1) Politoed's rain-boosted Weather Ball OHKOes frail special attackers like Houndoom and threatens Sneasler; (2) Garganacl's Protect is the primary stall tool and Wide Guard blanks Water spreads; (3) Light Clay screens (Reflect + Light Screen) from Grimmsnarl persist long enough to blunt special and physical breakers; (4) Mega Blastoise's Water moves are walled by Purifying Salt and easily Protected. Future plan: vs rain teams with Politoed, do NOT bring a competing Drizzle user; bring a non-Water special attacker (Earth Power/Energy Ball coverage) or a strong physical wallbreaker, plus a Taunt user to shut down Garganacl's Protect/Salt Cure cycling. Treat Grimmsnarl's Light Clay screens as a 5-turn timer and plan to break through before they fade.
